actions.confirmDescription: Confirming reserves stock for the order. Choose what to do if stock is short. A confirmed order cannot be edited.
actions.closeDescription: Closing stops the remaining undelivered quantity from being reserved. Give a reason.
actions.cancelDescription: Cancelling releases reserved stock. This only works before anything has been delivered.
actions.deleteDescription: This permanently deletes the draft sales order.
